products.name: Bangalore Club
products.subtitle: Bangalore in the 70s
products.short_desc: The gracious verandahs of the Bangalore Club, rendered in watercolour and personally signed by the artist.
products.description:
A watercolour reproduction of Paul Fernandes' illustration of the Bangalore Club — all cane chairs, colonnades and the unhurried afternoons of a bygone city.

Every print is personally signed by the artist before it ships.

products.name: Bangalore Palace
products.subtitle: Bangalore in the 70s
products.short_desc: Tudor turrets and fortified towers — the Bangalore Palace in soft watercolour.
products.description: The Tudor-Gothic silhouette of Bangalore Palace, drawn from memory and mood. A signed reproduction from the aPaulogy gallery.

products.name: The Only Place
products.subtitle: Bangalore in the 70s
products.short_desc: The steakhouse every old Bangalorean remembers — a nostalgic corner on Museum Road.
products.description: The Only Place — that timber-and-brick institution off Museum Road, where the steaks and the conversation were both slow-cooked. A signed watercolour print.

products.name: Frazer Town Underbridge
products.subtitle: Bangalore in the 70s
products.short_desc: Ducks waddling under the Frazer Town underbridge — a small, perfect city moment.
products.description: A line of ducks crossing beneath the Frazer Town underbridge. One of the most-loved illustrations in the aPaulogy collection, available as a signed print.

products.name: Chor Bazaar
products.subtitle: Vintage Mumbai
products.short_desc: The thieves' market of old Bombay, crammed with clocks, gramophones and stories.
products.description: Chor Bazaar — Bombay's legendary flea market, a jumble of brass, teak and forgotten treasure, captured in Paul Fernandes' unmistakable watercolour hand.

products.name: Cafe Mondegar
products.subtitle: Vintage Mumbai
products.short_desc: Colaba's beloved cafe, its walls alive with Mario Miranda's crowd.
products.description: A warm watercolour of Cafe Mondegar in Colaba — cold beer, a jukebox and the murmur of the city. Signed by the artist.

products.name: Goan Taverna
products.subtitle: Goa
products.short_desc: A whitewashed taverna, feni on the counter, the afternoon in no hurry.
products.description: Susegad in a single frame — a Goan taverna with its blue shutters and unhurried afternoons. A signed watercolour reproduction.

products.name: Indian Coffee House Mug
products.subtitle: The turbaned waiter
products.short_desc: The famous turbaned waiter of the Indian Coffee House, on a sturdy ceramic mug.
products.description: The turbaned waiter of the Indian Coffee House, balancing his tray, printed on a 325ml ceramic mug. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

products.name: Ambassador Car Coaster Set
products.subtitle: Set of 4 ceramic coasters
products.short_desc: Four ceramic coasters featuring the grand old Ambassador in four moods.
products.description: A set of four cork-backed ceramic coasters, each with a vintage Ambassador car illustration from the 70s. Boxed and ready to gift.

products.name: Duck Underbridge Laptop Bag
products.subtitle: Padded 15" sleeve
products.short_desc: Ducks at the Frazer Town underbridge on a padded canvas laptop bag.
products.description: A padded canvas laptop bag (fits up to 15") printed with the beloved ducks-at-the-underbridge illustration. Sturdy zip and a soft interior lining.

products.name: Old Bangalore Postcard Set
products.subtitle: Set of 12
products.short_desc: Twelve postcards of old Bangalore landmarks, printed on textured card.
products.description: A set of twelve postcards, each a different old Bangalore scene, printed on lightly textured 300gsm card. Perfect for framing or sending.

products.name: Bougainvillea Bungalow
products.subtitle: Bangalore in the 70s
products.short_desc: A monkey-topped bungalow spilling over with bougainvillea.
products.description: One of the graceful old bungalows of Bangalore, its gate spilling over with bougainvillea and a monkey on the roof. A signed watercolour print.
